make_benchmark_from_c_file: create an LLVM bitcode benchmark from a C or C++ source file path
make_benchmark_from_source_string: create an LLVM bitcode benchmark from a string of C or C++ source code
get_system_library_flags: get the system compiler include and library flags needed for compilation
split_benchmark_by_function: split an LLVM benchmark into individual single-function benchmarks using llvm-extract
merge_benchmarks: merge a list of LLVM benchmarks into a single benchmark using llvm-link
